issues.display_title: Issue #61: [Copilot] Support Clone & Conditional Unarchive Intents with Re-upload Guidance
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Implement RAG Copilot intent detection and action planning for Clone Tour and Unarchive Tour commands, enforcing Google Street View unarchive availability checks and outside-tour clarification.

Scope & Requirements

  1. Clone Tour Intent Detection:

    • Detect /clone command and natural language queries (clone tour, duplicate tour, copy tour).
    • Dispatch open_modal client action targeting clone_tour with auto_trigger: True.

  2. Unarchive Tour Intent & Disambiguation:

    • Detect /unarchive command and natural language queries (unarchive tour, restore tour).
    • Guard _ARCHIVE_TOUR_PATTERN with negative lookbehind (?<!un-)(?<!un) to prevent collision with archive commands.
    • When requested outside a tour and no tour is specified, return needs_context asking:

      "Please specify or mention which tour(s) you would like to unarchive."

  3. Google Street View Availability & Re-upload Fallback:

    • When viewing an archived tour where has_unarchive_button: False (tour is not found on Google Street View):
      • Suppress modal unarchive action.
      • Return deterministic guidance:

        "You can unarchive this tour by: Reupload 360 images with same file name to unarchived tour."

      • Provide navigation action to /my-tours/:mid/upload if user is outside the upload workspace.
    • When tour is active (archived: False), return informative active status without client actions.

  4. Hallucination Prevention:

    • In AnswerComposer, return direct deterministic responses when unarchive guidance is present in plan.reason to avoid LLM hallucinations regarding Google Street View import.

Acceptance Criteria

  • /clone and clone queries trigger open_modal for clone_tour.
  • Requests to unarchive outside a tour return needs_context clarification.
  • Active tours (archived: false) receive active status messages without unarchive triggers.
  • Archived tours lacking the Google unarchive button receive the concise re-upload guidance and upload navigation action.
  • All unit tests pass (pytest tests/).

issues.display_title: Issue #62: [Copilot] Support Merge Tour Intent Detection and Context Handling
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Implement RAG Copilot intent detection and action planning for Merge Tour commands, enabling users to trigger tour merge workflows via natural language and slash commands with proper outside-tour context handling.

Scope & Requirements

  1. Merge Tour Intent Detection:

    • Detect /merge command and natural language queries (merge tour, combine tours, join tours).
    • Dispatch open_modal client action targeting merge_tour with auto_trigger: True.
    • Include primary tour context (tour_id, business_name, and tour array in params).

  2. Context Disambiguation & Outside-Tour Clarification:

    • When requested outside an active tour page without mentioning a tour, return needs_context asking:

      "Please specify or mention which tour(s) you would like to merge."

    • When a specific tour is mentioned (@Tour), resolve it as the primary container tour.

  3. Planner Architecture:

    • Support imperative matching in both synchronous (plan) and asynchronous (aplan) planner methods.

Acceptance Criteria

  • /merge and merge queries trigger open_modal for merge_tour.
  • Requests to merge outside a tour return needs_context clarification.
  • Mentioned tour from outside resolves properly into params.tour_id.
  • All unit tests pass (pytest tests/).

Result

  • Added _MERGE_TOUR_PATTERN in app/copilot/planner.py supporting /merge, merge tour, combine tours, and join tours.
  • Integrated merge_tour modal dispatch into _detect_client_action and verified imperative routing across plan() and aplan().
  • Implemented clarification fall-through to needs_context when merge is requested outside tour context.
  • Added comprehensive unit test suite in tests/copilot/test_planner.py (test_planner_detects_merge_tour_modal_action).
  • Verified full test suite: 288 passed (100%).

issues.display_title: Issue #63: [Copilot] Support Split Tour Intent Detection and Gating Conditions
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Implement RAG Copilot intent detection and action planning for Split Tour commands, enforcing the exact operational conditions used in the GoThru dashboard (Blue Line tour only, >0 panoramas, unarchived, single tour).

Scope & Requirements

  1. Split Tour Intent Detection:

    • Detect /split command and natural language queries (split tour, split this tour, divide tour, splitting tours).
    • Dispatch open_modal client action targeting split_tour with auto_trigger: True.
    • Pass active tour context (tour_id, business_name, tour_type, total_panorama).

  2. Dashboard Gating Conditions:

    • Tour Type Check: Split Tour is exclusively supported on Blue Line tours (tour_type === 'sv_publishing'). If the tour is another type (e.g., hosted_tour, google_publish), suppress the client action.
    • Panorama Count Check: Tours with 0 panoramas (total_panorama == 0) cannot be split; suppress the client action.
    • Archive Status Check: Archived tours (archived === True) cannot be split; suppress the client action.

  3. Context Disambiguation & Clarification:

    • When requested outside an active tour page without mentioning a tour, return needs_context asking:

      "Please specify or mention which tour(s) you would like to split."

    • When a specific tour is mentioned (@Tour), resolve it as the target tour and validate conditions.

Acceptance Criteria

  • /split and split queries trigger open_modal for split_tour on eligible Blue Line tours with panoramas.
  • Requests to split non-Blue Line or 0-panorama or archived tours suppress the client action.
  • Requests to split outside a tour return needs_context clarification.
  • Mentioned tour from outside resolves properly into params.tour_id.
  • All unit tests pass (pytest tests/).

Result

  • Added _SPLIT_TOUR_PATTERN in app/copilot/planner.py supporting /split, split tour, divide tour, and splitting tours.
  • Implemented dashboard-exact gating checks in _detect_client_action (tour type sv_publishing, total_panorama > 0, and unarchived status).
  • Integrated clarification fall-through to needs_context when split is requested outside tour context.
  • Added comprehensive unit test suite in tests/copilot/test_planner.py (test_planner_detects_split_tour_modal_action).
  • Verified full test suite: 289 passed (100%).
